name: X-linked Ichthyosis Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for X-linked Ichthyosis

criteria.description: Presence of generalized, adherent, dark brown polygonal scales predominantly on the trunk and extensor surfaces
Demonstration of steroid sulfatase enzyme deficiency in leukocytes or skin fibroblasts
Identification of pathogenic deletion or mutation in the STS gene on chromosome Xp22.31
Positive family history consistent with X-linked inheritance pattern
Presence of asymptomatic punctate corneal opacities on slit-lamp examination

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic ichthyosis plus either steroid sulfatase deficiency or pathogenic STS gene mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is confirmatory; enzyme assay may be used when genetic testing is unavailable.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically involves trunk and extensor surfaces

Onset at birth with collodion membrane
